per_policy_run: reset prefix cache of A, B and R before each (session, policy, condition) run
retain: keep every model's prefix cache for the whole run (KV capacity: A 166,496 tok, B 40,880 tok; a long session needs < 18K tok)
evict: stress test: at a switch away from model m, POST /reset_prefix_cache on m's server immediately
cache_state_lookup: client-side record of prompt token ids sent to each server in this run; predicted hit = block-floored longest common prefix; checked against vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total every turn
